testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel the Reset Ribbon confirmation: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/ribbon-appearance/ribbon-appearance.feature:184:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel the Reset Ribbon confirmation ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon selected ✔ When the user right-clicks the Options panel title ✔ And the user opens Ribbon Appearance ✔ And the user selects Reset Ribbon ✔ Then a confirmation says ribbon customizations will be removed ✔ And the confirmation offers Yes and No ✔ When the user selects No ✔ Then the confirmation closes without resetting the ribbon ✔ And the full Tools ribbon and active part remain visible
